text:
maria_cs: FYI - Neuroforge (dedicated trial) dropped to ~10% of normal token volume overnight. Renewal in ~40 days. Can we triage? :warning:

jj_ae: Noted. Any sign this is a product-side outage vs customer throttling? I chatted with their AM and they mentioned pausing some nightly ETL jobs yesterday for cost reasons.

amy_data: Quick metric slice shows tokens/hr fell from ~4.5k to ~420 between 2025-11-03 01:30 and 03:00 UTC. Error breakdown: 92% success -> 7% 401 -> 1% other. No 5xx spike. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/neuroforge/overview (internal)

sam_se: I'll run a targeted synthetic against their dedicated host. If we're seeing intermittent 401s it could be a signing key rotation mismatch.

leo_onboard: Onboarding noticed some long initialization times on their eval nodes last week; they might have aborted warmup and shutdown jobs. I can push the warmup script and small sample job to them.

incident_bot: [ALERT] sudden-usage-drop detected for customer: neuroforge. Suggested runbook: triage-auth, triage-usage-patterns. Incident ref: INC-NEU-20251103-7

sam_se: Synthetic results: 100 health pings -> 94 OK, 6 401s. Auth header shows token issued at 2025-11-02T23:58:12Z, but cluster still validating old key id. Looks like the token signer rotated but validators didn't pick up new key for the trial cluster.

amy_data: SQL I used (quick):

```
SELECT hour, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) as hour, tokens
  FROM usage.events
  WHERE customer_id = 'neuroforge'
    AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
) s
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour desc
LIMIT 48;
```

Drop window pinned to 2025-11-03 01:30 UTC. Attached CSVs: /shared/neuroforge/2025-11-03-usage.csv

jj_ae: Customer-side cost throttles explain part of it but not the auth gap. Claire (procurement) noted they paused large batch embeds yesterday morning. Recommend we treat this as hybrid cause.

maria_cs: Proposed immediate steps:
- Sam: fix key-sync on trial validators + force-refresh key cache (owner @sam_se). ETA 90m.
- Leo: send warmup script + a 1-page runbook to Claire and prod ops (owner @leo_onboard). ETA 4h.
- Amy: prepare an hourly baseline vs drop chart for exec QBR (owner @amy_data). ETA 2h.
- JJ: coordinate an offer: 10% credits for two weeks + free cost report vs Lexa pilot. (owner @jj_ae). ETA EOD.

leo_onboard: Will include steps for re-enabling paused jobs safely and recommended batch chunk size to avoid surprise bills.

sam_se: Deploying validator sync now. Patching token cache TTL to 2m and forcing rotation reconciliation. Will post logs.

incident_bot: [ACTION] INC-NEU-20251103-7 assigned to oncall-eng. Priority: P2.

sam_se: Patch applied. Validator keyset now matches signer on trial cluster. 401 rate dropped from 7% -> 0.3% in 12 minutes. Monitoring link: https://infra.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-NEU-20251103-7

amy_data: Traffic recovered to ~79% of baseline 30m after patch. CSV updated: /shared/neuroforge/2025-11-03-recovery.csv

jj_ae: I'll draft the cost-safety note and include a suggested short demo comparing latency/cost vs Lexa for the same workload.

maria_cs: Good work. If we don't hit >70% baseline within 24h -> escalate to renewal-engage track. Meanwhile, JJ please get Claire's availability for a 30-min QBR next week.

leo_onboard: Warmup script push complete; customer confirmed a small pilot restart started.

incident_bot: [RECOVERY] INC-NEU-20251103-7 resolved automatically after traffic normalized to 82% baseline.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Follow-ups: JJ to send outreach + offer, Amy final slide, Sam confirm no further token TTL regressions, Leo verify customer job restart success. Reconvene if any regressions. :thumbsup:
